info.name: eAccountNoteService API
info.description:
Complete Postman Collection for all endpoints of eAccountNoteService backend API.

### Authentication & Frontend Interceptor Compatibility (groupAccount)
- In the `groupAccount` frontend (`api.js`), every authenticated request sends:
  - `accesskey: window.LoginAccount.AccessKey` (the encrypted Bearer Token)
  - `userid: window.LoginAccount.UserId`
- The backend (`AuthActionFilter.cs`) validates the Bearer token from either `accesskey` or `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, and verifies that `userid` matches the claim.
- This collection is configured to automatically attach both `accesskey` and `userid` headers via collection-level pre-request script and explicit headers.

### Automatic Token Extraction
- Authenticating via `home/AuthorizeMe`, `home/getUserOrgProfile`, `user/AuthorizeMe_Otp`, or `api/UserOrg/getUserOrgProfile` automatically extracts `AccessKey`, `UserId`, and `OrgId` into `{{accessKey}}`, `{{userId}}`, and `{{orgId}}` collection variables.

### Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
- **Roles**: Super Admin (`100`), Admin (`1`), Normal User (`2`), Auditor (`3`)
- **Permission Codes**: Defined in each request description (e.g. `org.view`, `bill_order.create`, `receipt.download`, `report.download_pdf`, etc.).
